name: Minnesota

notes: Food for home consumption is exempt.
6.875% sales tax plus the 2.5% liquor gross receipts tax.
Cigarettes are not subject to the general sales tax at retail (an in-lieu tax is paid at the wholesale level); other tobacco and e-cigarettes are taxable.
Motor fuel is exempt from the general sales tax (per-gallon excise instead).
gaps: Local rate in each city is the most common combination among its ZIP+4 records (county, city and special taxing district taxes such as the metro-area transportation and housing taxes).
Lodging, entertainment, food-and-beverage and other local taxes on specific goods are not included.
